<!-- Generated by apps/docs/scripts/generate-ui-reference.mjs. -->

Nest Item under Root and put Trigger and Content inside each item. Match the Root value to its type. Single mode uses a string and multiple mode uses an array. Each Item has its own value.

## Usage

```ts
import { accordion, components } from '@viewstem/svelte-ui/shadcn/accordion';
```

The set ID is `shadcn/accordion`. It [registers](../../registration/) 4 components for use in JSON.

### Example View

Register the `accordion` set and pass this JSON as `view` to `renderer.mount`.

```json
{
  "render": {
    "id": "faq",
    "componentRef": "shadcn.Accordion.Root",
    "inputs": {
      "type": "single"
    },
    "slots": {
      "default": [
        {
          "id": "shipping",
          "componentRef": "shadcn.Accordion.Item",
          "inputs": {
            "value": "shipping"
          },
          "slots": {
            "default": [
              {
                "id": "question",
                "componentRef": "shadcn.Accordion.Trigger",
                "inputs": {
                  "text": "Shipping"
                }
              },
              {
                "id": "answer",
                "componentRef": "shadcn.Accordion.Content",
                "inputs": {
                  "text": "Two business days"
                }
              }
            ]
          }
        }
      ]
    }
  }
}
```

Open “Shipping” to reveal the delivery estimate.

## JSON reference

Inputs without **Required** are optional. In a type, `?` marks an optional object field. **Default** shows a literal default declared by the Svelte wrapper. Other defaults are unspecified here and may come from the underlying component, the browser, or other inputs.

<a id="shadcn-accordion-root"></a>

### `shadcn.Accordion.Root`

Native exports include `components.Root`, `components.Accordion`.

| Input | JSON type | Details |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `type` | `"single" \| "multiple"` | **Required** |
| `aria-label` | `null \| string` |  |
| `class` | `string` |  |
| `disabled` | `boolean` |  |
| `id` | `string` |  |
| `loop` | `boolean` |  |
| `orientation` | `"horizontal" \| "vertical"` |  |
| `placeholder` | `null \| string` |  |
| `text` | `string` |  |
| `value` | `string \| Array<string>` |  |

<details>
<summary>Additional HTML and ARIA inputs</summary>

| Input | JSON type | Details |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `color` | `null \| string` |  |
| `data-disabled` | `string \| boolean` |  |
| `data-icon` | `string \| boolean` |  |
| `data-invalid` | `string \| boolean` |  |
| `role` | `string` |  |
| `style` | `string` |  |

This part also supports the [listed shared inputs](../../attributes/#attributes-c337cc7871).

</details>

Slots `child`, `default`.

The [DOM events for this part](../../attributes/#dom-67a0f1612c) use a [direct payload](../../support/#event-payloads).

| Event | `value` in payload | Codec and constraints |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `valueChange` | `string \| Array<string>` | — |

## Native types and composition

In Svelte, use `ComponentProps<typeof components.Root>` for the native prop type. Snippets, function props, DOM refs, and bindings follow the native types.
